text:
alice: Need a micro-playbook for the v1->v2 deprecation: banner text, PR template, snippets (py/ts/go), and redirects. Publish target: 2025-05-30 morning.
bob: I can own the PR template + labels + add a link-checker workflow. Will include checklist: files touched, snippets updated, smoke test link, redirects.
carol: I'll draft a concise model-mapping table and a short note about embedding dimension changes and reindex guidance.
dan: I'll produce side-by-side snippets and a temporary shim example. Quick shim example to show in migration guide:
```python
# v1 (old)
resp = client.models.invoke("gpt-redwood-01", input="hello")
# v2 (new)
resp = client.responses.create(model="gpt-redwood-01", input=[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}])
```
docs-bot: automation tip: generate redirects for /v1/* -> new pages once mappings are finalized; set reminder for banner verification.
alice: Great. Post PR links here when ready and I'll assemble the one-page playbook that links each PR. If smoke tests fail, tag #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
